description: Complete system overview documenting the bail bonds management system architecture, key components, and high-level workflow
Detailed documentation of core data models including bond classifications, time buckets, case management entities, and their relationships
Documentation of critical time-based algorithms including booking window calculations, time bucket management, and case prioritization logic
Comprehensive documentation of the multi-tenant authorization system with role hierarchies, department/county-level permissions, and access control rules
Documentation of data flow through the system, focusing on case enrichment processes, verification workflows, and integrations with external providers
